# pve_node_disks (Data Source)

Physical disks of a node (list) with optional S.M.A.R.T. health for one disk.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_node_disks" "example" {
  node = "pve1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.

### Optional

- `disk` (String) Block device name
- `healthonly` (Boolean) If true returns only the health status
- `include_partitions` (Boolean) Also include partitions. (default: 0)
- `skipsmart` (Boolean) Skip smart checks. (default: 0)
- `type` (String) Only list specific types of disks. One of: `unused`, `journal_disks`.

### Read-Only

- `disks` (Attributes List) Returned by /nodes/{node}/disks/list. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--disks))
- `id` (String) Identifier: <node>.
- `overview` (String) Raw JSON payload returned by /nodes/{node}/disks (the API schema does not describe its shape).
- `smart` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--smart))

<a id="nestedatt--disks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `disks`

Read-Only:

- `devpath` (String) The device path
- `gpt` (Boolean)
- `health` (String)
- `model` (String)
- `mounted` (Boolean)
- `osdid` (Number)
- `osdid_list` (List of Number)
- `parent` (String) For partitions only. The device path of the disk the partition resides on.
- `serial` (String)
- `size` (Number)
- `used` (String)
- `vendor` (String)
- `wwn` (String)
